C1_estimator.mechanism: peak-pick over whole record vs fundamental at shedding frequency
C1_estimator.verdict: CONFIRMED — legacy peak-pick overstates by up to +36 %; fundamental estimator recovers the limit-cycle amplitude (D40 +2.8 %).

C2_window.mechanism: start-up transient inside the averaging window
C2_window.verdict: CONFIRMED — transient is 4–22 % of the record; excluding it is mandatory (m16827 D3).

C3_grid.mechanism: grid resolution (D_cells) — the residual error after C1/C2
C3_grid.verdict: CONFIRMED as residual — cl_amp error drops from +17.8 % (D28) to +2.8 % (D40); the D28→D40 span (14.5 %) exceeds the 3 % convergence criterion, so D≥48 is required to close the ladder.

C4_tau.mechanism: τ (same Re, same geometry, different u_mean)
C4_tau.verdict: MARGINAL — Δτ=0.014 moves cl_amp by ~4 % (m23014 H2); not the driver of the +35 %.

C5_boundary.mechanism: half-way bounce-back effective diameter D+1 (O(1/D) bias)
C5_boundary.verdict: FALSIFIED as the +35 % driver — the bias is monotone O(1/D) (5 %→1.8 %) and cannot produce the non-monotone cl_amp error cliff (m23014 H3).

C6_anisotropy.verdict: FALSIFIED — the lattice is square (dx = dy = D/10) at every level; no anisotropic cell aspect ratio.

C7_collision.mechanism: MRT vs BGK — both recover ν=(τ−0.5)/3; MRT adds non-hydrodynamic damping (s_e=1.64, s_eps=1.54, s_q=1.7)
C7_collision.verdict: NOT THE DRIVER — the case runs MRT with the standard relaxation rates; the recovered ν is identical to BGK. A BGK-vs-MRT A/B at fixed ν is a follow-up, not a precondition for the +35 % attribution.

C8_force.mechanism: Ladd momentum-exchange force (F = 2·Σ c_i·f_i on solid)
C8_force.verdict: NOT THE DRIVER — mean lift ≈ 0 (|cl|/cd < 1 %) and mean drag is positive at every level; the force sign/scale is consistent with the momentum-exchange convention. cd/st/dp all land <5 % at D40, so a global force-scale error is excluded.
